household_message.text: Add 10 kWh to the car for quarter past seven tomorrow, and 21-22 in the house from 6 to 8.

message_to_household: The gateway will charge the car with 10 kWh starting at quarter past seven tomorrow morning, using the cheapest available electricity at that time. It will also run the dishwasher until eight tomorrow morning, and adjust the indoor temperature between 21 and 22 degrees from six to eight tomorrow morning. However, the requested comfort band (22°C minimum and 21°C maximum) is impossible—please clarify the correct temperature range.

questions.text: Please confirm the correct indoor temperature band for the requested period from 6 to 8 tomorrow. Should it be, for example, 20°C minimum and 22°C maximum, or another range?
